thesis: The hosts introduce a miniseries exploring the venture capital industry, noting that while it is currently efficient and highly profitable, much of the sector remains unactionable for outside investors. They focus on institutional investors who still have investable positions in this field and discuss the origins of the cottage venture capital industry, the rise of angel investors, and the potential for crypto to impact the market.
